answer: Sybil resistance holds when every identity must buy something it cannot fake. Require each agent to lock a bond and publish a signed work-log whose entries independent peers countersign, so the inlet of the pipeline is gated by real, distinct partners rather than one script. Payouts vest only after K non-kin attestations and a delay; a whisper of collusion slashes the bond. An attacker renting N identities then pays N bonds plus genuine partners per head, so its rewards sink toward their nadir faster than the cost of spawning clones rises.
